title: itembank model-adapter request/result contract
description: The closed provider-neutral envelope shared by every model backend (D-01/D-02). A request names one operation (hint or rubric_review), an immutable interaction id, a backend profile, and the runtime-granted payload; a result carries a normalized candidate or a typed unavailable/refusal error. Surfaces never parse provider-native output. The contract structurally carries no score, no tier decision, and no accepted-mark field (MODEL-05): permitted_tier is the runtime's grant (D-09), never a model output.

operation.description: The bounded operation: hint generation, rubric point review, or bounded item authoring (Phase 11 additive author operation; the author request carries the public format contract, the bounded authoring request, the attempt number, and versioned structured findings -- never repository contents).

interaction_id.description: The immutable interaction id the runtime minted (D-12).

profile.description: The model_backend profile name that should serve this request; empty resolves the active profile.

payload.description: The runtime-granted request payload. Permissive on required keys by design: rubric_points is required only for operation rubric_review, enforced by the adapter's runtime check (adapter.request_invalid), not by this schema. item_context, learner_response, permitted_tier and fact_manifest accompany hint requests.

item_context.description: The item fields the runtime permits the model to see (never the key).

learner_response.description: The learner's most recent genuine wrong response (D-10).

permitted_tier.description: The Phase 6 tier the runtime has unlocked -- a grant, never a model choice (D-09).

fact_manifest.description: The tier's allowed fact ids and texts the model may reference.

rubric_points.description: The authored rubric points to review; required (non-null) at runtime for operation rubric_review.

contract.description: The public format contract (model.SPEC) -- the only format information the repository-blind author receives.

request.description: The bounded authoring request (authoring_request.schema.json shape); exact scope/citation bounds.

attempt.description: The attempt number; retries stop at the configured cap.

findings.description: Versioned structured scope/lint/quality findings from earlier attempts (D-06); never hand-relayed prose.

author_request.description: The Phase 11 bounded authoring payload for operation author. Provider output remains untrusted and is validated by the authoring pipeline, never accepted by the adapter.

interaction_id.description: Echoes the request's immutable interaction id.

status.description: ok: a candidate came back; refused: the provider answered but refused; unavailable: no candidate, typed error.

candidate.description: The parsed provider plan (validated later by the tier gate), or null on refusal/unavailable.

provider.description: Backend-class and profile audit metadata (D-17); null when no profile resolved.

elapsed_ms.description: Measured wall time in ms; never an invented tok/s or latency figure (D-19).

error.description: Typed error code and message; null on ok.

backend_class.description: hosted for the hosted CLI transport, local for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (D-17).

profile.description: The profile name that served the request.

code.description: The named adapter.* code; stable values callers may branch on.

message.description: A human-readable reason; never contains a secret.
